title: God's will for humanity and the adversary's plot
english: The God of all things, since he is life and life-giving, willed that humanity be an incorruptible living creature on earth, even though its nature is corruptible. But the adversary, because he was wicked and envious, plotted against the human race. He was opposing the will of the Creator. He cunningly brought humanity down into disobedience, knowing that through it humanity would fall into death.
